subject: Embed sync & rerank validation: integration playbook and risk triage
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Riley <tom.riley@acme-retail.com>, Priya Anand <priya.anand@acme-retail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2027 15:09:00 -0700
Subject: Embed sync & rerank validation: integration playbook and risk triage

Tom/Priya —

Thanks again for the time today. After the demo we discussed a couple of scope notes that I want to capture so we have shared expectations going into the implementation:

Goals (30/60/90):
- 30 days: ingest indexed product catalog, verify embedding quality on a 10k sample, run rerank smoke tests.
- 60 days: complete backfill for the first 3 business-critical indices (~150k docs), integrate prefix caching, and stabilize latency under 200ms p95.
- 90 days: full production cutover with canary & rollback plan; automated rerank regression alerts.

Key open items we need to resolve:
1) Vector store choice: you mentioned an internal managed cluster (FAISS on EKS) vs using a hosted vector DB. We should align on latency/cost constraints and persistence SLA.
2) Backfill strategy: streaming vs bulk seed + windowed reindexing. For large catalogs we usually recommend a hybrid: seed with bulk job, then stream deltas and reconcile.
3) Rerank evals: we’ll run a blind A/B on the 10k prompt set and a manual quality review for top-5 results. Need a contact for labeling/prioritization.

Attached: integration checklist and a short sample prompt set to seed the rerank evaluation.

Proposed next steps:
- Confirm vectorstore decision by EOD Thu (Mar 11)
- Quick sync Thurs to walk the chronology of the backfill job (15–20m)
- Share rerank eval template and labeling cadence

If that matches your reading, I’ll loop in our engineering lead (Karthik) and CS lead (Monica) for the implementation plan.

Thanks —
Jordan Blake
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0132

Attachments: redwood_acme_integration-checklist.xlsx, acme_sample_prompts.md

From: Tom Riley <tom.riley@acme-retail.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Anand <priya.anand@acme-retail.com>, search-platform@acme-retail.com
Date: Thu, 11 Mar 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Embed sync & rerank validation: integration playbook and risk triage

Jordan —

Appreciate the clear plan. A few clarifications from our side after an internal sync:

Vector DB: we are currently running FAISS on an internal EKS cluster. The operations team is wary of additional managed services because of data residency, but we are open if Redwood can guarantee KMS integration and a clear data deletion policy.

Backfill volume: the initial catalog for phase 1 is ~150k items but there are many fields (variants, localized descriptions). We are concerned about tokenization and embedding drift if we change model families mid-backfill.

Rerank evals and labels: Priya will coordinate labeling — estimated 3–4 analysts available part-time. That may limit the throughput of manual QA. Can Redwood provide an initial automatic scoring step to triage candidates?

Proposed times: Thu 11:30–12:00 or Fri 9:00–9:30PT for a quick operational sync.

Onwards —
Tom
Tom Riley
Staff ML Engineer, Search & Personalization | Acme Retail
tom.riley@acme-retail.com

Team — forwarding ACME thread and pulling together ask/assignments. High level: they want fast time-to-value but insist on on-prem/residency controls. Key risks below with suggested owners.

Risks & owners:
- Data residency / KMS (owner: Karthik) — confirm HSM/KMS compatibility and produce short security note for their Ops.
- Backfill model drift (owner: Marissa) — define seed+stream plan and decide whether to pin a model; provide a rollback mitigation and acceptance criteria.
- Labeling throughput (owner: Monica) — estimate manual review capacity and propose an auto-triage scoring (we can run a cheap cross-encoder rerank as a filter).

Quick asks from each of you before Monday:
- Karthik: short note (1 paragraph) on KMS/integration constraints and what we can guarantee today.
- Marissa: outline a 60-day backfill timeline with checkpoints + monitoring hooks.
- Monica: draft a rerank eval process with expected analyst hours and the auto-triage threshold.

I’ll propose two slots with ACME and include a Drive link with the rerank eval template.

Jordan
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 08:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Embed sync & rerank validation: integration playbook and risk triage

Jordan/Karthik/Monica —

Draft 60-day backfill + rerank eval plan (high level):

Week 0–1: confirm vectorstore + KMS, finalize schema (who owns id mapping and localized fields).
Week 2–3: bulk seed job (staging) — run on a snapshot; run integrity checks (doc counts, checksum).
Week 4: run sampling and embedding sanity on 10k; produce quality report.
Week 5–6: incremental stream job + reconcile; cutover canary to 5% traffic.
Week 7–8: expand canary to 25% and run rerank A/B.
Week 9–10: stabilization and full cutover.

Rerank evals: propose 3 evaluation buckets — relevance (automatic), diversity (manual), business-safety (manual). Attach rerank-eval-template.csv for labeling and suggested sampling weights.

Monitoring checkpoints: p95 latency, top-5 relevance delta, precision@k on labeled set, embeddings cosine distribution drift alarm.

I’ll attach the CSV and a short playbook for rollback criteria.

Marissa Cole
Implementation Manager | Redwood Inference

Attachments: rerank-eval-template.csv

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Riley <tom.riley@acme-retail.com>, Priya Anand <priya.anand@acme-retail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 18 Mar 2027 09:32:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Embed sync & rerank validation: integration playbook and risk triage

Tom/Priya —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Based on our internal alignment (thread below) we propose the following concrete plan and dates:

1) Vectorstore + security (Mar 19–23): Karthik will produce the KMS/HSM note and a short security appendix we can hand to your Ops. We will confirm the final storage option by Mar 23.
2) Bulk seed (Mar 24–28): run bulk seed to staging (snapshot), run integrity checks and seed embeddings.
3) Sampling sanity + rerank baseline (Mar 29–Apr 2): run 10k sample, auto-score candidates and send to Priya’s analysts for manual review using the attached CSV template.
4) Canary (Apr 5–9): 5% traffic canary with rollback hooks.
5) Expand & cutover (Apr 12–23): run 25% -> 100% ramp with monitoring and scheduled QA windows.

Deliverables we’ll share this week:
- Security appendix (Karthik)
- 60-day backfill schedule + monitoring checklist (Marissa)
- Rerank eval template and auto-triage threshold (Monica)
- Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3c4d5e

Action for you: please confirm the March 19 security sync and provide availability for the Mar 24 bulk seed (we’d like a 30m kick-off). If you prefer a managed vector DB instead of your FAISS cluster, flag that now — we’ll scope KMS and deletion policy into the SOW.

If you’re good, I’ll generate a mutual action plan doc in HubSpot and send a DocuSign SOW for the reserved engineering block.

Best —
Jordan Blake
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
